description.value: The Cowichan Community Centre is a regional-district-operated community facility in Duncan, BC, formerly known as the Island Savings Centre. It serves the broader Cowichan Valley area as a multi-use civic venue. A touring cyclist passing through Duncan might consider it a potential rest stop, though specific cycling-oriented amenities are not confirmed.
